title: session-memory: session_search + session_read tools for the librarian subagent
context: Repo: dotfiles, extensions workspace at pi/.pi/agent/extensions (bun workspaces + bun test). Verify gate: .pi/config.json = mise run lint-changed + mise run typecheck. Grill-me alignment settled: two tools mirroring wiki_search/wiki_read, hosted ONLY in the librarian subagent (gate on PI_LIBRARIAN_LOAD like exa-search/context7), conversation-only transcript rendering (user+assistant text; assistant toolCall blocks collapsed to one-line summaries; toolResult messages and thinking blocks dropped), main-path tree flattening (last-entry-wins, walk parentId to root), deterministic 1..N numbering over rendered messages shared by both tools, previous sessions only (exclude live parent session via PI_PARENT_SESSION_FILE env set by librarian from ctx.sessionManager.getSessionFile()), smart-case regex search, CHEAP_MODEL.
architecture: Session storage: ~/.pi/agent/sessions/--<encoded-cwd>--/<ISO-ts>_<uuid>.jsonl, JSONL tree entries linked by id/parentId (docs/session-format.md). Encoding (not exported from SDK root, reimplement locally): resolvePath(cwd).replace(/^[/\\]/,'').replace(/[/\\:]/g,'-') wrapped in '--'. Roles in message entries: user, assistant, toolResult (+ bashExecution, custom, branchSummary, compactionSummary — treat non user/assistant as skipped). New extension dir pi/.pi/agent/extensions/session-memory (package @pi-ext/session-memory, pi.extensions [./index.ts], tsconfig extends base). Pure helpers exported for tests: sessionDirFor(cwd, agentDir), parseSessionFile(lines) -> {entries, mainPath}, renderTranscript(messages) -> numbered lines, executeSessionSearch(params, ctx-ish), executeSessionRead(params). Librarian changes (librarian/index.ts + constants.ts): additionalExtensionPaths += session-memory, tools allowlist += session_search/session_read, set PI_PARENT_SESSION_FILE (with finally cleanup) before loader.reload(), prompt widened: mission includes past session history, tools listed, output format Sources/Findings/Open Threads, routing: session tools preferred over wiki for repo-history questions. Exa-search integration.test.ts is the pattern for gating tests; wiki-read for execute tests with temp dirs.

design.currentState: Pi auto-saves every conversation as JSONL tree files under ~/.pi/agent/sessions/--<encoded-cwd>--/ but nothing can query them: no extension reads past sessions, the wiki (librarian's only local memory source) is rarely used, and the main agent has no way to recall past decisions. Session format knowledge is tribal; raw JSONL is noisy (tool calls, branch trees, JSON escaping) and unusable with plain grep.
design.desiredState: A librarian-internal extension session-memory registers two tools when loaded by the librarian subagent (PI_LIBRARIAN_LOAD gate): session_search (smart-case regex over rendered conversation-only transcripts, returns session handle + message number + matched excerpt, excluding the live parent session via PI_PARENT_SESSION_FILE) and session_read (deterministic numbered transcript ranges, offset/limit, date-prefix session disambiguation). Librarian prompt/allowlist/paths updated; main agent context untouched. Cheap model does the digging; main agent gets the synthesis.
design.patterns: Gating: exa-search/context7 top-of-export PI_LIBRARIAN_LOAD check. Tool shape: wiki-search/wiki-read (TypeBox params, content+details result, throw on error not return). Subagent session: librarian createLibrarianSession with noExtensions+additionalExtensionPaths+explicit tools allowlist, env-var signaling around loader.reload() with finally cleanup. Tests: mock.module with @pi-ext/shared/test-mocks factories; unit tests colocated; integration.test.ts per extension; temp dirs for fs fixtures (mkdtempSync from node:fs — Bun.makeTempDir does not exist).
design.decisions: Two tools (search+read) not one combined tool — mirrors wiki_search/wiki_read, keeps results small. Conversation-only rendering (user+assistant text, toolCall collapsed to one line, toolResult/thinking dropped) — tool results judged not useful for recall. Main-path flattening, last entry wins via parentId walk — retries/forks invisible, numbering deterministic across both tools. Librarian hosting on CHEAP_MODEL over a new subagent — same infra, zero main-agent tool surface, wiki stays as secondary source until it withers. Exclusion via PI_PARENT_SESSION_FILE env (refcounted like PI_LIBRARIAN_LOAD not needed — single parent per process; set/unset in finally). Date-prefix lookup added to session_read (cheap disambiguation for 'last Tuesday' queries).
design.questions: None blocking. Deferred: semantic/embedding search if sessions fully replace the wiki; multi-fork sessions beyond last-entry-wins sanity-checked with fixture only.
